description: We are a team of passionate student developers focused on data science, AI, geospatial technology, and solving real-world problems. Our project, HomeTruth, combines NASA Earth observation data, climate trends, and FEMA hazard information to help people understand environmental risks affecting their homes and communities. We bring experience in software development, GIS, and data analysis, and welcome collaborators skilled in AI, data visualization, UI/UX, and full-stack development.
